name: pointwise-guarded-certificate
cmd: set -e; bash research/track-m/prepare-vendors.sh; bun install --frozen-lockfile >/dev/null; out=$(mktemp /tmp/incl-min.XXXXXX); trap 'rm -f "$out"' EXIT; timeout -s KILL 30 bun research/mldr-incl/minimize-pointwise.ts certificate-input/guarded-domain.br "$out" 16 2700; test -s "$out"; bun research/mldr-incl/verify-pointwise.ts "$out"
